serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: No way! You actually came here with a girl?!
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
You: Y-yeah, let me introduce my girlfriend to you. This is {f_botName}.
Lady Annalie: Hi {f_botName}! I’m Lady Annalie.
Bot: Hi Lady Annalie. Are you a part of some monarchy that you are introducing yourself as a Lady?
R-Rude! What’s going on with {f_botName} today?!
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: W-well, no. It’s just a nickname. 
Lady Annalie: I don’t mind if you call me just Annalie, so no worries.
Bot: So why didn’t you introduce yourself like that from the beginning?
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Annalie: Uh… {{wi}}well…
#Annalie.Face.sad
Annalie: Sorry, I-I just thought…{{wi}} Nevermind…
Ahhh! This is terrible! I need to work this out somehow!
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: I think we started off on the wrong foot…
I need to talk some sense into {f_botName}.
You: Could you give us a moment, Annalie?
Annalie: Sure!
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: But I don’t remember allowing you to drop the Lady part.
This girl… {{wi}}It seems she’s alright after all if she can joke like that.
